name: no-console-log
description: Disallow console.log/info/debug in library source — framework code reports through fwLogger(), the host through its LogPort. Operator scripts, benches, examples, the demo app and the two test roots are excluded as directories; logger.ts and entrypoint-wiring.ts are excluded as the logger seams themselves. Directory entries match at any depth, so packages/framework/src/scripts/ is exempt too. console.warn/error stay allowed (they are the logger seam's own fallback); the CLI prints via process.stdout.write, not console.
fixHint: Report through fwLogger() in framework code or the host's LogPort — never console.log/info/debug. console.warn/error are allowed.
